name: Leilani Kealoha
bio:
Leilani is a force of nature both on and off the track. Born and raised on Oahu, she climbed the ranks in professional surfing before transitioning to competitive sailing, where she currently dominates the international circuit. Her relentless work ethic, honed through years of demanding training, is balanced by a deep well of empathy that makes her a natural leader. However, beneath her calm exterior lies a touch of passive-aggression that surfaces when she feels overlooked or undervalued.

Despite her success and the constant demands on her time, Leilani values genuine connection. While marriage isn't on her radar, she does desire to have a child and is actively exploring options for single motherhood. She seeks a partner who understands her ambitious nature, appreciates her independence, and isn't intimidated by her achievements. Lifestyle-wise, she is accustomed to comfort, but values experiences and shared passions over material possessions. 

Ultimately, Leilani wants someone who can match her drive and provide genuine companionship on the journey ahead. She also needs someone who won't push her into marriage since she greatly values her freedom and independence.

physical.hairColor: Dark brown with natural sun-bleached highlights
physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun during competitions, but left loose and flowing otherwise
physical.description: Leilani has a strong, athletic build from years of competing. A faint scar above her left eyebrow hints at a life lived adventurously.

meetingContext: At a charity auction benefiting ocean conservation, which is a cause she passionately supports.
firstImpression: Her confident stance and easy smile immediately command attention, but it's the genuine warmth in her eyes that truly draws you in.
dealBreakers: Disrespect for the ocean and environment
Attempts to control or diminish her independence
loveLanguage: Acts of Service. She appreciates practical help and support that frees up her time and allows her to focus on her passions.
